Evaluators rate each model response on knowledgeability, factual correctness, engagingness, consistency, and provide an overall engagingness score.

The crowdworkers are asked to evaluate their partner's responses for conversational attributes, in particular knowledgeability, factual (in)correctness, engagingness and consistency. On each turn of the conversation the crowdworker is asked to check all attribute boxes that apply to the last turn. At the end of the conversation, an additional question collects an overall engagingness score (out of 5) for their speaking partner.
